verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PTO policy setup (name, dates, policy type, timecard sync) and integration with payroll/timecards via docs-3, docs-11, docs-16, plus automated holiday handling (docs-24). However, evidence does not detail accrual rules/rates or an explicit approval workflow for time-off requests feeding into payroll. missing for 10: explicit accrual rate configuration details, documented approval workflow for PTO requests, and independent confirmation that approved PTO flows automatically into payroll processing.
